trained_on: SID_Set real vs full_synthetic -- CIFAKE never seen in training
threshold_note: Acc@0.5 and AUC are zero-shot: the SID-trained checkpoint is applied to CIFAKE with no target-domain tuning. Acc@opt is CALIBRATED ON TARGET -- the decision threshold is fit to maximise balanced accuracy on a random 50% split of CIFAKE test (using CIFAKE labels), then scored on the held-out 50%. It answers 'how well could this model do on CIFAKE if allowed to tune one scalar', an upper bound on deployable transfer -- not zero-shot.
freq_caveat: CIFAKE is 32px; the frequency stream sees mostly upscaling artifacts, not generator residuals.
